results.name: Closed player ignores paragraph clicks and adds no affordance
Local nested inline click starts the chosen paragraph and resumes paused audio
Static nested inline click starts the chosen paragraph and resumes paused audio
Links, controls, editable text and excluded content keep their normal behavior
Modified clicks, text selection and double-click do not seek
Rapid paragraph requests ignore late obsolete renders
Clicking the tail of a split paragraph starts its first segment
Close and cleanup cancel pending paragraph timers and handlers

limitations: Synthetic audio clocks test interaction and cancellation; native real-recording paragraph seeking is tested separately on the finished export.
